items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: One of them was Alfred Nord. He was a violin man in Oakland.

ctx.x: Would you remember that individual's name?

One of them was Alfred Nord. He was a violin man in Oakland. And the woman in San Francisco -- had a woman teacher -- a woman head of the orchestra -- Miss [crossed out: Ma.] Neppert. She was an older woman.
Do you remember how to spell the name?
